Smalti VERSION for Linux (x86-64): Tessera as a plugin
=========================================

In this folder:
  Smalti.clap    the CLAP instrument (Bitwig, Reaper, ...)
  Smalti.vst3    the VST3 instrument (a folder: copy the whole folder)

There is no standalone app on Linux yet.

Install
-------
  mkdir -p ~/.clap ~/.vst3
  cp Smalti.clap ~/.clap/
  cp -r Smalti.vst3 ~/.vst3/

Then rescan the plugins in your DAW. Smalti is an instrument, under "Rastapopolix".

Until beta 4 Smalti was called Tessera: delete the old copies first, so the DAW doesn't find it twice
(songs saved with them open in Smalti):

  rm -f ~/.clap/Tessera.clap; rm -rf ~/.vst3/Tessera.vst3

It needs X11 (or XWayland) for its window, and zenity or kdialog for the OPEN and SAVE dialogs.
Built on Ubuntu 24.04: an older distribution may lack a new enough C++ library.

The manual for the plugin: https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/blob/main/PLUGIN.md
What's in this beta, and what isn't yet: BETA_NOTES.md in this folder.
Found a problem? https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/issues (the plugin's version, your DAW and its
version, the distribution, the steps, what you expected and what happened).

Smalti (the Tessera firmware as a plugin) is free software under the GPL-3.0 (LICENSE). Credits and the licences of the parts it uses:
LICENSING.md.
